queries.label: Defender · Recent sign-ins by this agent
queries.code:
// ===== ESS Agent 365 · Recent sign-ins by this agent =====
AADSpnSignInEventsBeta
| where AppId == "ed4046aa-a3ef-4685-a73d-ecda5a4f01da"
| where Timestamp > ago(24h)
| project-reorder Timestamp, AppDisplayName, ResourceDisplayName, IPAddress, ErrorCode
| sort by Timestamp desc

queries.label: Graph · List access reviews touching this agent
Defender · CA decisions for this agent
queries.code:
AADSpnSignInEventsBeta
| where AppId == "ed4046aa-a3ef-4685-a73d-ecda5a4f01da" and Timestamp > ago(7d)
| extend CAStatus = tostring(parse_json(AdditionalFields).ConditionalAccessStatus)
| summarize count() by CAStatus, ErrorCode, ResourceDisplayName
| sort by count_ desc

queries.label: Defender · Risky users served by this agent
queries.code:
AADUserRiskEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| join kind=inner (
    CloudAppEvents
    | where AccountObjectId == "ed4046aa-a3ef-4685-a73d-ecda5a4f01da"
    | distinct UserId = tostring(parse_json(RawEventData).TargetUserId)
  ) on $left.UserId == $right.UserId
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, RiskLevel, RiskState

queries.label: Purview · Audit search (M365 UAL)

Search-UnifiedAuditLog -StartDate (Get-Date).AddDays(-1) -EndDate (Get-Date) `

  -ObjectIds 'ed4046aa-a3ef-4685-a73d-ecda5a4f01da' -ResultSize 50 |
  Select-Object CreationDate, Operations, UserIds, AuditData

queries.label: Defender · Cross-correlate audit + sign-ins
queries.code:
CloudAppEvents
| where AccountObjectId == "ed4046aa-a3ef-4685-a73d-ecda5a4f01da" and Timestamp > ago(24h)
| project Timestamp, ActionType, ObjectName, AccountUpn, IPAddress

name: Agent Security Posture Management (ASPM for AI)

queries.label: Defender · Is the agent registered?
queries.code:
// ===== ESS Agent 365 · Is the agent registered? =====
AIAgentsInfo
| where AIAgentId == "ed4046aa-a3ef-4685-a73d-ecda5a4f01da"
    or AIAgentName has "ESS"
    or CreatorAccountUpn has "svasireddy"
| project-reorder Timestamp, AIAgentId, AIAgentName, AgentStatus, CreatorAccountUpn
| sort by Timestamp desc

queries.label: Defender · Behavior anomalies
queries.code:
// ===== ESS Agent 365 · Behavior anomalies =====
BehaviorEntities
| where EntityType == "AIAgent"
| where EntityId == "ed4046aa-a3ef-4685-a73d-ecda5a4f01da" or EntityName startswith "ESS"
| join kind=inner (BehaviorInfo) on BehaviorId
| project-reorder Timestamp, EntityName, ActionType, Severity, Description, Categories
| sort by Timestamp desc

queries.label: Defender · Detection rule template (destructive tool block)
queries.code:
// ===== ESS Agent 365 · Detection rule template (destructive tool block) =====
CloudAppEvents
| where AccountObjectId == "ed4046aa-a3ef-4685-a73d-ecda5a4f01da"
| where ActionType == "AgentToolDenied"
| project-reorder Timestamp, AccountUpn, ObjectName, RawEventData
| sort by Timestamp desc

queries.label: Defender · 7-day activity summary
queries.code:
// ===== ESS Agent 365 · 7-day activity summary =====
CloudAppEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountObjectId == "ed4046aa-a3ef-4685-a73d-ecda5a4f01da" or AccountDisplayName has "ESS"
| summarize count() by ActionType, AccountDisplayName
| sort by count_ desc

queries.label: Defender · Alerts referencing this agent
queries.code:
// ===== ESS Agent 365 · Alerts referencing this agent =====
AlertEvidence
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where AccountObjectId == "ed4046aa-a3ef-4685-a73d-ecda5a4f01da" or AdditionalFields has "ed4046aa-a3ef-4685-a73d-ecda5a4f01da"
| join kind=inner (AlertInfo) on AlertId
| project-reorder Timestamp, Title, Severity, Category, AttackTechniques, ServiceSource
| sort by Timestamp desc
